bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder November 10, 2018

The Guild of Harwich Artists (GHA) Gallery is now open November 23, Black Friday, and Saturday & Sunday of Thanksgiving Weekend.  The member run gallery will also be open Friday, November 30 for the Christmas Stroll, as well as Saturday, December 1 and Sunday, December 2. After that the GHA Gallery will be open Saturday & Sunday, December 8 & 9, and 15 & 16.  We are closing for the season on December 16th.

The Art Gallery will be selling framed miniature GHA member hand-painted ornaments starting the night of the Christmas Stroll; and will have a Winter theme wall on display. 

Posted in Ornament Fundraiser, THE ART GALLERY, WHAT'S NEW
